story.iWant: the design system configured with Marmorani's visual identity
story.soThat: all UI components follow the "Luxe Minimaliste Moderne" aesthetic

tasks.task: Configure Tailwind CSS design tokens Update globals.css with Carrara Pure theme colors as CSS variables Add Nero Marquina theme colors as CSS variables in .dark class Add semantic colors (success, warning, error, info) for both themes Configure spacing scale (xs through 3xl) as CSS variables Extend @theme inline with custom color naming (carrara-*, marquina-*, gold accent)

Configure typography with next/font Import Cormorant Garamond from Google Fonts via next/font/google Import Inter from Google Fonts via next/font/google Import JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts via next/font/google Configure font subsets (latin, latin-ext for European languages) Create CSS variables for each font family (--font-display, --font-body, --font-mono) Add font utility classes to @theme inline (font-display, font-body, font-mono)

Create CSS variables for theme switching Define CSS custom properties in globals.css for light theme (Carrara Pure as default) Add dark theme CSS custom properties using .dark class (Nero Marquina) Create variables for: background, foreground, surface, border, accent, muted colors Ensure shadcn/ui existing variables are properly extended/overridden

Update RootLayout component Update src/app/layout.tsx (or create src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx for i18n prep) Apply font variables to document body (font-display, font-body, font-mono) Add theme provider wrapper (simple class toggle for MVP) Configure proper html attributes (lang, suppressHydrationWarning) Add metadata configuration (title: Marmorani, description)

Create Header component Create src/components/layout/Header.tsx Implement minimal top bar with logo/brand text (Marmorani) Add desktop navigation (placeholder links: Gallery, Configurator, Account) Add mobile hamburger button with icon (Lucide React) Style with Carrara Pure theme (white background, charcoal text #1A1A1A) Add responsive breakpoints (hide nav on mobile, show hamburger) Add cart icon with badge placeholder

Create Footer component Create src/components/layout/Footer.tsx Add company info section (Marmorani brand) Add legal links section (Privacy, Terms - placeholder) Add contact info section (placeholder email/phone) Style with consistent design system tokens Add copyright notice with dynamic year

Create LocaleSwitcher component Create src/components/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx Display current locale as native language name Create dropdown with 5 locales: English, Français, Italiano, Español, Deutsch Add language switching placeholder (console.log, full implementation in Story 1.4) Style as subtle dropdown, matching header aesthetics

Create layout index and integrate components Create src/components/layout/index.ts for clean exports Integrate Header and Footer in RootLayout Add main content wrapper with proper styling Verify responsive layout works on mobile and desktop
Create theme utility components Create src/components/ThemeProvider.tsx (simple theme context) Add hook useTheme() for theme access Add theme toggle utility (for configurator page dark mode)

Final verification Run npm run dev and verify layout renders correctly Verify fonts are loading without layout shift Verify responsive breakpoints work (mobile/desktop) Verify theme colors match design spec Run npm run build - ensure no errors Run npm run lint - ensure no linting errors

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Carrara Pure theme colors are defined: Background #FFFFFF, Surface #F8F8F8, Border #E5E5E5, Text primary #1A1A1A, Text secondary #4A4A4A
Nero Marquina theme colors are defined: Background #0D0D0D, Surface #1A1A1A, Accent (gold) #C9A962, Text primary #FFFFFF, Text secondary #B3B3B3
Semantic colors are defined for both themes: Success (green), Warning (amber), Error (red), Info (blue)
Typography system is configured with Google Fonts via next/font: Cormorant Garamond (display), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (mono)
Spacing scale is configured: xs:4px, sm:8px, md:16px, lg:24px, xl:32px, 2xl:48px, 3xl:64px
CSS variables are defined for runtime theme switching (light ↔ dark configurator)
RootLayout component is implemented with font loading via next/font, theme provider integration, proper HTML structure with locale support
Header component is implemented with minimal top bar design, charcoal text on light background, hamburger menu on mobile, desktop horizontal navigation, logo/brand display
Footer component is implemented with contact information placeholder, legal links placeholder, consistent styling with design system
LocaleSwitcher component is implemented displaying current locale, showing language names in native form (Français, Italiano, etc.), placeholder for locale change functionality

doc.title: Marmorani UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Dual-atmosphere approach: Carrara Pure (light, general site) with bg #FFFFFF, surface #F8F8F8, border #E5E5E5, text primary #1A1A1A, text secondary #4A4A4A. Nero Marquina (dark, configurator) with bg #0D0D0D, surface #1A1A1A, accent #C9A962, text #FFFFFF.

doc.title: Marmorani UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Font selection: Cormorant Garamond (500-700) for headlines/display, Inter (300-500) for body text, JetBrains Mono (400) for dimensions and technical specs. Type scale: H1 3rem, H2 2.25rem, H3 1.5rem, Body 1rem.

doc.title: Marmorani UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Base Unit: 4px. Tokens: xs 4px, sm 8px, md 16px, lg 24px, xl 32px, 2xl 48px, 3xl 64px. Layout grid: 12-column with 24px gutters. Container max-width: 1280px.

doc.title: Marmorani UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: CSS variable definitions for implementation including --color-bg, --color-surface, --color-accent, --font-display (Cormorant Garamond), --font-body (Inter), --font-mono (JetBrains Mono), spacing tokens, and transition defaults.

doc.title: Marmorani Architecture
doc.snippet: Components location: src/components/layout/ for Header.tsx, Footer.tsx, Navigation.tsx, LocaleSwitcher.tsx. Layout in src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx for i18n routes.

doc.title: Marmorani Architecture
doc.snippet: Styling: Tailwind CSS 3.x with utility-first design token support. UI Components: shadcn/ui (minimal, accessible, full control). i18n: next-intl for 5 locales (en, fr, it, es, de).

doc.title: Marmorani Architecture
doc.snippet: Standard component structure: interface ComponentProps, hooks first (useTranslations, useStore), derived state with useMemo, event handlers, then render. React functional components with TypeScript.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification
doc.snippet: AC1.3.1-10: Carrara Pure colors, Nero Marquina colors, semantic colors, 3 fonts via next/font, spacing scale, CSS variables for theme switching, RootLayout, Header, Footer, LocaleSwitcher components.

doc.title: Marmorani PRD
doc.snippet: "Luxe Minimaliste Moderne": refined elegance with bold contemporary touches. Clean white spaces meet striking contrasts. Color palette: predominantly white and light neutrals with sophisticated accents (charcoal, gold, deep marble tones). Bold modern typefaces for headlines, clean sans-serif for body.

constraints.constraint: Carrara Pure Theme Default: Light theme is default for all pages except configurator
Nero Marquina for Configurator: Dark theme used specifically for 3D configurator immersive experience
Gold Accent #C9A962: Used for primary CTAs and price displays - the luxury signature color
Tailwind v4 Configuration: Uses @theme inline directive in CSS instead of tailwind.config.ts
next/font Optimization: Google Fonts loaded via next/font for zero layout shift
shadcn/ui Integration: Extend existing CSS variable system, don't replace it
Component Pattern: PascalCase files, props interface, hooks first, derived state, handlers, render
Path Aliases: @/* maps to ./src/* - use for all imports
Components Directory: Layout components go in src/components/layout/, UI in src/components/ui/
Responsive Design: Desktop horizontal nav, Mobile hamburger → fullscreen overlay
Typography Hierarchy: Display (Cormorant Garamond) for headings, Body (Inter) for UI, Mono (JetBrains) for prices/dimensions

tests.standards:
Visual and build verification for this story: - npm run dev must start without errors - npm run build must complete successfully - npm run lint must pass with no errors - Fonts must load without visible layout shift (FOUT) - Theme colors must match UX spec exactly - Responsive breakpoints must work correctly
No unit tests required - visual verification and build passing are the tests.
